decoded.continuousMinMax: Words 1 (Min) and 2 (Max) are the target parameter stored words: the target codec decodes them to the displayed values (Rotary Rate 3299 -> 0.503 Hz, 42097 -> 6.424 Hz; Amp graphic EQ band 3 32854 -> 0.03, 43630 -> 3.98; Wah Control 0 -> 0.00, 65534 -> 10.00).
decoded.midSlope: Mid (word 4) and Slope (word 6) display word / 65534 in percent (30368 -> 46.3 %, 39651 -> 60.5 %; 32767 -> 50 %).
decoded.scale: Scale (word 13) displays 10^((w - 32767) / 32767): 32767 -> 1.000, 39366 -> 1.590 (one non-default point; the 10^x form is the fit, range 0.1..10 if it holds).
decoded.sourceDisplayNumber: The Source list number shown on the FM3 is the stored source code + 1: 51 -> "52 Control Switch 2", 53 -> "54 Control Switch 4", 14 -> "15 External 1"; 0 -> "1 NONE".
decoded.switchMinMax: Switch targets: word 1 (Min) / word 2 (Max) 0 -> OFF, 65534 -> ON; 1707 (2.6 % of 65534) displays OFF. Inverted 65534/0 shows Min ON, Max OFF.
decoded.channelWord17: Word 17 = 4 displays Channel "CHAN D" (0 ALL, 1..4 CHAN A..D, as the policy table).
decoded.autoEngageWord10: Word 10 = 5 displays Auto-Engage "MED POS"; 0 displays OFF.
decoded.attackReleaseWords7and15: Words 7 and 15 = 66 display Attack 10.1 ms and Release 10.1 ms; 65 displays 9.9 ms for both. Both words changed together in this corpus, so which word is Attack and which is Release is not separated.
decoded.defaultsOfTheModifyPage: Default binding page: Min OFF, Max ON, Start 0.0 %, Mid 50 %, End 100 %, Slope 50 %, Scale 1.000, Offset 0.0 %, Damping EXPONENTIAL, Auto-Engage OFF, Off Value 5.0 %, PC Reset OFF, Update Rate SLOW.
decoded.offValueWord12: Word 12 = 0 and 65534 both displayed Off Value 5.0 %: word 12 is not Off Value (unresolved).

notResolved: Start / End / Offset away from their defaults
findings: The FM3 default template written by controlSwitches displays as the default Modify page: Min OFF, Max ON, full curve defaults, channel ALL.
Source numbers on the FM3 screen are 1-based (stored code + 1).
Switch Min/Max are stored 0 / 65534; an inverted binding stores 65534 / 0.
Continuous Min/Max are stored in the target parameter own word encoding (three targets, six points), so a display-unit Min/Max can be encoded with the target codec.
